texts.preamble: Mahesh Kumar Sharma vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 February, 2021 Author: B. K. Shrivastava Bench: B. K. Shrivastava 1 Mcrc-5924-2021 The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh Mcrc-5924-2021 (Mahesh Kumar Sharma Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh) 4 Jabalpur, Dated : 26-02-2021
texts.facts: Samples have been taken two times, which are found adulterated/misbranded. Total 11 samples were taken out of them 10 were found misbranded. On 09.11.2020 the again samples were taken and as per analysis report, thus the 2 MCRC-5924-2021 products were found substandard and misbranded.
texts.arguments: It is submitted by the applicant's counsel that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case. It means he is doing the business of milk product with the business of transport.
